whatThisPluginAdds.text: Before and After adds a Layout Builder widget for comparing two local images with a bounded range control. The public comparison supports keyboard and touch interaction with a non-interactive fallback.

surfaceOutcome.text: Editors select the two images and comparison settings in Layout Builder, and visitors can move the public reveal control to inspect the difference.

developers.text: A typed widget definition keeps editor input, render data, and the Blade fallback behind one registered Layout Builder extension.

teams.text: Teams can explain visual changes in one focused component without preparing separate image states or custom comparison code.

troubleshooting.cause: The path is a web address or contains characters outside letters, numbers and `_ / . -`
troubleshooting.check: Check the before and after image fields
troubleshooting.fix: Pick both images from the media library

troubleshooting.cause: The alt text or label is empty, or the starting position is outside 0 to 100
troubleshooting.check: Check both alt texts, both labels and the starting position
troubleshooting.fix: Fill every alt text and label, and set the position between 0 and 100
